No. 25A376
In The
Supreme Court of the United States
______________________
SAMANTHA ESTEFANIA FRANCISCO CASTRO,
Applicant,
v.
JOSE LEONARDO BRITO GUEVARA,
Respondent.
On Application to the Honorable Samuel A. Alito, Jr., 
Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States 
and Circuit Justice for the Fifth Circuit 
RESPONDENT’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE SEALED 
SUPPLEMENTAL APPENDIX
Respondent respectfully requests this Court grant Respondent leave to file 
Respondent’s Supplemental Appendix under seal pursuant to United States Supreme 
Court Rule 34. In support of the motion, Respondent states as follows: 
1. Respondent’s Supplemental Appendix contains transcripts from a trial
involving a minor. 
2. The transcripts in Respondent’s Supplemental Appendix were sealed in 
the district court below. See Supp.App.9:18–10–7 (ordering, on the record in open 
court, that the record of the proceeding would be sealed because it involves sensitive 
information concerning a minor).

3. The seal from the court below remains in effect, and such sealing 
continues to be necessary to maintain the confidentiality of the information
concerning a minor. 
4. Respondent respectfully requests that Respondent’s Supplemental 
Appendix be sealed indefinitely due to the ongoing and sensitive nature of the 
proceeding involving a minor. 
5. Due to the expedited nature of these proceedings, Respondent is not 
presently able to provide a redacted copy of these records.

Respectfully submitted.
